$Comment: Keeps a boss bound into the Boss slot whatever form he takes, and holds him to his arena. Each
tick, any NPC of BossGroups in reach is locked into the slot: a boss who changes role mid-fight
comes back as a new entity, and this is what holds the fight on him. The Orbis boss template runs
it in every phase; list every form of the boss in his group.
The leash: while the bound boss stands farther than LeashRange from the script's entity, the
script notifies him with LeashMessage (the game's Notify, straight to the Boss slot, carrying the
script's entity as the sender), every tick until he is back inside it. His roles answer it by
turning back toward the fight, so he never follows a player out of it; a role that does not listen
for the message ignores it. Nothing here touches his health: only the fight's reset does. Keep
LeashRange a few blocks inside the fight's ArenaRange and well inside Range, past which the

BossGroups.Description: NPC groups holding the boss in every form.

Range.Description: How far from the script's entity the boss is looked for.

LeashRange.Description: How far from the script's entity the boss may go before he is called back toward it.

LeashMessage.Description: The message the boss is notified with while he is past LeashRange. His roles listen for it by this name.

Instructions.$Comment: Binds any boss of BossGroups in reach into the Boss slot.
The bound boss is past LeashRange: call him back. The message lasts a second and is sent again each tick he stays out.
